extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from the primary paper. Prior automated membrane/nucleic-acid/protein-synthesis notes were rejected as locator noise.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Dec-RVKR-cmk inhibits flavivirus maturation by preventing furin-mediated prM cleavage, increasing the prM/E index in treated ZIKV- and JEV-infected Vero cells.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: dec-RVKR-cmk against ZIKV and JEV in Vero cells
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper supports prM-cleavage inhibition for ZIKV/JEV; it does not support importing DRAMP SARS-CoV-2 spike/syncytium mechanism text into this DOI.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Dec-RVKR-cmk reduces extracellular ZIKV and JEV progeny titers and viral RNA/protein readouts in a dose-dependent manner, with source-supported IC50 values recorded in the activity layer.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Dose-response evidence supports antiviral effect and associated readouts, while exact figure-only curve points beyond textual values are not invented.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: One-step growth and release/infectivity assays support that dec-RVKR-cmk acts on virus release and next-round infectivity rather than first-round viral RNA replication.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: ZIKV release/infectivity assays in Vero cells
mechanism_claims.limitations: The current paper supports release/infectivity inhibition; it does not establish broad antimicrobial or HBV/SARS-CoV-2 activity for this DOI.
